title: Other Things I Build
carving-content: I transform old hardcover books into hidden compartments or interactive objects. Each piece is carved by hand and designed around both the original material and the destination.
board-content: I design small tabletop games inspired by themes and objects I enjoy. I develop and refine the rules to strike a balance between playability and enjoyment, translating these inspirations into game mechanics.
marbles-content: I build handcrafted mazes and interactive pieces using  marbles I kept from childhood. A way to turn forgotten objects back into something playful and interactive.
